# Above the match threshold, findOrCreate returns the existing person

**Claim.** Name plus email clears the minimum match combination, so the existing person comes back as a 302 match stub with a Location header, and nothing is written.

Applies to: `~1people~1findOrCreate/post`

## Observed exchange

_The person is already in the database._

```http
(setup) POST /people/create

{
  "firstName": "Marisol",
  "lastName": "Vega-{scope}",
  "emails": [
    {
      "email": "marisol.vega-{scope}@example.com"
    }
  ]
}

→ 201
  Location: https://api.securevan.com/v4/people/100000001
{
  "vanId": 100000001,
  "status": "Stored"
}
```

_findOrCreate with the same name and email: found, not created._

```http
POST /people/findOrCreate

{
  "firstName": "Marisol",
  "lastName": "Vega-{scope}",
  "emails": [
    {
      "email": "marisol.vega-{scope}@example.com"
    }
  ]
}

→ 302
  Location: https://api.securevan.com/v4/people/100000001
{
  "vanId": 100000001,
  "status": "Matched"
}
```
